units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.label: Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1. The head of a municipality is its highest official and is vested by the municipal charter, in accordance with this Article, with their own powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipal charter, the head of a municipality is elected:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) in municipal elections;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) by the representative body of the municipality from among its members;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3) by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 4) by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates presented by a competition commission on the basis of a competitive selection procedure.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipal charter, the head of a municipality may head the local administration.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 4. Where the representative body of a municipality elects the head of the municipality from among its members, the mandate of the deputy elected as head of that municipality terminates.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 5. The election of the head of a municipality by its representative body from among its members is generally held at the first meeting of the new convocation of the municipal representative body.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 6. If a candidate for the office of head of a municipality fails to obtain the number of votes required for the representative body to adopt a decision electing the head from among its members, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall, within 10 days, appoint a person to temporarily exercise the powers of the head of the municipality from among persons who, on the date of appointment, are not subject to restrictions on the right to stand for election under the legislation on basic guarantees of electoral rights and the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in a referendum.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 7. For a vote by the representative body of a municipality to elect the head from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, that highest official shall present at least two candidates to the representative body.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 8. The procedure for the preliminary consideration of candidates for the office of head of a municipality by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and for presenting them to the representative body of the municipality is established by a law of that constituent entity. Proposals of candidates for the office of head of a municipality may be submitted to the highest official of the constituent entity by political parties whose federal lists of candidates were admitted to the allocation of deputy mandates on the basis of the officially published results of the most recent preceding elections of deputies of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation; political parties whose lists of candidates were admitted to the allocation of deputy mandates in the legislative body of the constituent entity in office on the date those proposals are submitted to the highest official; the council of municipalities of the relevant constituent entity; the civic chamber of that constituent entity; and the Association “All-Russian Association for the Development of Local Self-Government”. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, other organizations may submit proposals of candidates for the office of head of a municipality to the highest official of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 9. A candidate for the office of head of a municipality may be a citizen who, on the date candidates for that office are presented to the representative body of the municipality, is not subject to restrictions on the right to stand for election under the legislation on basic guarantees of electoral rights and the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in a referendum.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 10. The procedure for conducting a competition to select candidates for the office of head of a municipality is established by the representative body of the municipality. The procedure must provide for publication of the competition conditions and information about its date, time and place no later than 20 days before the competition date. The total number of members of the competition commission in a municipality is established by the representative body of the municipality. Half of the commission’s members are appointed by the representative body of the municipality concerned, and the other half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 11. The competition conditions may provide for requirements concerning professional education and/or professional knowledge and skills that are preferable for the head of the municipality to exercise powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may establish requirements, to be taken into account in the competition conditions, concerning the level of professional education and/or professional knowledge and skills that are preferable for the head of the municipality to exercise individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 12. For a vote by the representative body of a municipality to elect the head from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results, at least two candidates registered by the competition commission shall be presented to the representative body.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 13. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changing the procedure for electing the head of a municipality is adopted, the charter of the municipality concerned must be brought into conformity with that law within three months after the law enters into force.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 14. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changing the procedure for electing the head of a municipality is adopted, that procedure applies after the expiry of the terms of office of the heads of municipalities elected before the date on which that law enters into force.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 15. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for the head of a municipality to be elected by the representative body of that municipality is adopted, elections of the head of that municipality shall not be called or held if that law entered into force before the date from which the representative body would have been entitled to decide to call elections of the head in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on elections and referendums.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 16. The head of a municipality may not exercise the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 17. The head of a municipality must observe the restrictions and prohibitions and perform the duties established for persons holding municipal offices by Article 28 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 18. The head of a municipality is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the population and the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 19. The head of a municipality submits annual reports to the representative body on the results of their activities and, where the head also heads the local administration, on the results of the activities of the local administration and other subordinate local self-government bodies, including the resolution of matters raised by the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 20. In accordance with the principle of unity of the system of public authority, the head of a municipality simultaneously holds a state office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal office.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 21. If the head of a municipality cannot exercise their powers because of their health or other circumstances temporarily preventing the exercise of those powers (in particular, leave or an official business trip), the powers are temporarily exercised by a local self-government official designated in accordance with the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 22. In the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation appoints a person to temporarily exercise the powers of the head of a municipality until the day the head of the municipality is elected in accordance with the established procedure and takes office.
units.label: Part 22 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 23. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality has the rights and duties of the head of the municipality.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 24. The scope of the powers of a person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality may be limited by the municipal charter and/or by the regulatory legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation appointing that person (in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law).
units.label: Part 24 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 25. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, is subject to the duties, restrictions and prohibitions established for the head of a municipality for the purposes of combating corruption by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 26. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, submits, in accordance with the procedure established for the head of a municipality, information on their income, property and property-related obligations, and information on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouse and minor children.
units.label: Part 26 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 27. A person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law, additionally submits the information specified in part 26 of this Article within 15 days after appointment. The information submitted shall cover income received from all sources during the calendar year preceding the year of appointment, and property and property-related obligations as of the date of appointment.
units.label: Part 27 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Head of a municipality. Person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 28. Violation of the requirements established by parts 25–27 of this Article is a ground for early termination of the powers of a person temporarily exercising the powers of the head of a municipality who is appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the cases provided for in part 6 of this Article and part 16 of Article 21 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 28 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.label: Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1. The following fall within the exclusive competence of the head of a municipality:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) representing the municipality in relations with local self-government bodies of other municipalities, state authorities, citizens and organizations;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) signing and promulgating, in accordance with the procedure established by the municipal charter, regulatory legal acts adopted by the representative body of the municipality;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3) issuing legal acts within the limits of their powers;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 4) the right to demand that an extraordinary meeting of the representative body of the municipality be convened.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2. The head of a municipality who heads the local administration ensures the exercise by local self-government bodies of powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3. Other powers of heads of municipalities are determined by federal laws and by constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal charters adopted in accordance with them.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1. The powers of the head of a municipality terminate early in the cases provided for in part 1 of Article 30 of this Federal Law and also in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) loss of the confidence of the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) removal from office;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3) dismissal from office;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 4) a lasting inability, established by a court, to exercise the powers of head of the municipality on grounds of health;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 5) transformation of the municipality in accordance with parts 6 and 7 of Article 12 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 6) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 7) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will.
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2. The representative body of a municipality may, in accordance with this Federal Law, remove the head of the municipality from office at the initiative of deputies of the representative body or at the initiative of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3. The grounds for removal of the head of a municipality from office are:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) decisions or actions (inaction) of the head of the municipality resulting in the consequences provided for in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of Article 38 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) failure for three or more months to perform duties to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, to exercise powers provided for by this Federal Law, other federal laws and the municipal charter, and/or to ensure that local self-government bodies exercise individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3) an unsatisfactory assessment of the head of the municipality’s activities by the representative body, given twice consecutively on the basis of the head’s annual report to that body;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 4) failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established for persons holding municipal offices in accordance with part 5 of Article 28 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 5) the head of the municipality, the local administration, other local self-government bodies and officials of the municipality and subordinate organizations allowing widespread violations of state guarantees of equality of human and civil rights and freedoms on grounds of race, ethnicity, language, attitude to religion or other circumstances, restrictions of rights and discrimination on grounds of racial, ethnic, linguistic or religious affiliation, where this has disrupted interethnic and interfaith harmony and contributed to the emergence of interethnic and interfaith conflicts;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 6) systematic failure to attain indicators of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities.
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 4. An initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office, proposed by at least one third of the established number of deputies, is formalized as an appeal submitted to the representative body. The appeal is submitted together with a draft decision of the representative body to remove the head from office. The head of the municipality and the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be notified of the initiative no later than the day following submission of the appeal to the representative body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 5. An initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office is considered taking into account the opinion of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 6. If consideration of an initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head from office is to include matters concerning the assurance that local self-government bodies exercise individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and/or decisions or actions (inaction) of the head resulting in the consequences provided for in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of Article 38 of this Federal Law, a decision to remove the head from office may be adopted only with the consent of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 7. An initiative by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to remove the head of a municipality from office is formalized as an appeal submitted to the representative body of the municipality together with a draft of its corresponding decision. The head of the municipality shall be notified of the initiative no later than the day following submission of the appeal to the representative body.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 8. An initiative to remove the head of a municipality from office on the ground provided for in point 6 of part 3 of this Article is submitted to the representative body by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Such an initiative may be submitted by that highest official no earlier than one year after the head of the municipality took office.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 9. An initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality or by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to remove the head of the municipality from office is considered by the representative body within one month after the relevant appeal is submitted.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 21
